guidelines.text: Abnormal FNA/cytology result phrases are KẾT_QUẢ_XÉT_NGHIỆM.
Admission-reason and current-symptom repetitions are retained as separate span-level entities.
All chronic disease mentions and the medication mention under pre-admission history are isHistorical.
All chronic-history cardiovascular, renal, and cognitive diagnoses keep isHistorical.
All five diagnosis/risk-factor mentions are in historical/chronic context and keep isHistorical.
All four symptoms are current and keep empty assertions.
All seven entities are current and keep empty assertions.
Anatomic-only, severity-only, aggravating-factor, generic-reference, and missing-information phrases remain excluded.
Angiography/chụp mạch máu is a test name and keeps empty candidates.
Aortic dissection and paraplegia in medical history keep isHistorical.
Bare kali lab mentions are test names; potassium supplementation spans use RxNorm 8591.
Biopsy can be TÊN_XÉT_NGHIỆM because it produces histology results.
Both radiculopathy mentions remain current because they are the admission reason and current symptom; a years-long onset alone does not make an active condition historical.
Both repeated lower-GI bleeding and dizziness mentions are retained as separate span-level entities.

Both tăng nhãn áp mentions occur in head-CT, infancy shunt-placement, and repeated shunt-revision context; they are contextually hydrocephalus rather than literal glaucoma and therefore use G91.8 instead of supplied H40.0.
Both unstable-angina mentions remain current despite one occurring before transfer because they describe the active episode under evaluation.
Brand drugs normalize through RxNorm aliases when dictionary support exists.
Brand/generic drugs should normalize through RxNorm when the dictionary supports it.
Breast cancer and recurrent left pleural effusion in medical history keep isHistorical.
Breast cancer history keeps isHistorical.
Bypass/stent wording is excluded because Phase 1 has no procedure/intervention output type.
CEA, MRI, ultrasound, and biopsy mentions are TÊN_XÉT_NGHIỆM with no candidates in strict v0.
CT and lumbar-puncture diagnostic-test occurrences plus negative results are retained separately.
CT angiography is TÊN_XÉT_NGHIỆM; the aortic dissection findings are CHẨN_ĐOÁN.
CT head without contrast mentions are TÊN_XÉT_NGHIỆM; subdural hematoma finding is CHẨN_ĐOÁN.
Chest X-ray wording không cho thấy bằng chứng scopes viêm phổi and các đám mờ as isNegated.
Chest and right-foot X-ray names are diagnostic tests under TÊN_XÉT_NGHIỆM and are restored.
Chronic Graves disease and hyperlipidemia keep isHistorical.
Chronic cardiac/renal diagnoses and failed kidney transplant history keep isHistorical.
Chronic cardiometabolic diagnoses keep isHistorical.
Chronic cardiometabolic/renal diseases and pre-admission/home medications keep isHistorical.
Chronic cardiovascular diagnoses keep isHistorical.
Chronic diabetes and hypertension keep isHistorical.
Chronic diabetes and hypertension mentions keep isHistorical.
Chronic diagnoses and pre-admission medications keep isHistorical.
Chronic disease mentions keep isHistorical.
Chronic diseases, pre-admission diarrhea, and pre-admission Tylenol/Mucinex D keep isHistorical.
Chronic diseases, risk-factor repeats, prior ACom aneurysm treatment, and pre-admission angiography findings keep isHistorical.
Chronic diverticular disease and pre-admission Colace keep isHistorical.
Chronic history diagnoses and allergy-listed furosemide keep isHistorical.
Chronic history diagnoses and pre-admission Coumadin mentions keep isHistorical.
Chronic malignancies and medications listed before this admission keep isHistorical.
Chronic osteomyelitis, neurogenic bladder, and lower-limb paralysis keep isHistorical.
Chronic-history diagnoses and pre-admission Gleevec mentions keep isHistorical.
Chụp CT bụng, chậu, không thuốc cản quang is a diagnostic imaging test name, not a treatment procedure.
Combivent nebs uses multi-ingredient RxNorm 214199 rather than supplied spray code 1190220; iv magnesium uses source-backed magnesium sulfate RxNorm 6585 in the acute-asthma treatment context.
Coronary angiography and perfusion imaging are TÊN_XÉT_NGHIỆM; abnormal and anatomic disease findings are separated when text supports them.
Creatinine tăng and potassium values with sample-quality text are kept as KẾT_QUẢ_XÉT_NGHIỆM spans.
Current GI/urinary symptoms are candidate-free and not negated.
Current abdominal pain, constipation, nausea, bowel-pattern symptoms, tests/results, and acute-cholecystitis mentions keep empty assertions.
Current abdominal pain, pale mucosa, and mild nausea remain present symptoms/signs.
Current abdominal symptoms, fever, and tachycardia keep empty assertions.
Current chest-tightness and dyspnea occurrences keep empty assertions.
Current dyspnea, pericardial effusion, and imaging metastasis findings are not historical.
Current fistula diagnosis is present, while rung động is a current physical sign with no candidate.
Current hospital imaging findings are current, not historical.
Current intermittent chest discomfort, dizziness, dyspnea, and diaphoresis mentions keep empty assertions.
Current large paraoesophageal hernia and its descriptive imaging findings keep empty assertions.
Current medication wording đang dùng thuốc keeps weekly taxol and fulvestrant current, not historical.
Current prolapse, urinary, constipation, vaginal dryness, dyspareunia, and vaginal bleeding symptoms remain patient-present with empty assertions.
Current psychiatric manifestations such as tự tử, ảo giác, lú lẫn, and chóng mặt are TRIỆU_CHỨNG.
Current symptoms keep empty assertions; explicit Không scopes fever, dizziness, lightheadedness, and bleeding as isNegated.
Current symptoms such as đau bụng dưới and chảy máu nhiều are TRIỆU_CHỨNG.
Current ultrasound and diagnostic concern cholecystitis mentions are current.
